name: Summer Internship/Minor Project
description: This course involves taking up a summer internship or a minor project in industry or an academic research institution under the mentorship of a faculty member from the industrial engineering and operations research group. The students will be exposed to problems motivated by real-life applications from various industries or research projects of high socio-economic value. The students will take up this project during the summer after their first year. The deliverables will include a final report, presentation, and other relevant submissions like code, software, etc.
